name: Being A Servant
overview: Scripture reveals that true greatness in the kingdom of God is marked by humble service rather than authority or lordship over others, as Jesus teaches that those who desire to be first must become servants of all. Christ Himself exemplified this servant leadership by coming not to be served, but to serve and give His life as a ransom. Faithful service is commended and rewarded by the Lord, who honors those who follow and serve Him. Thus, being a servant is central to Christian discipleship, reflecting Christ’s example and promise of joy and honor for faithful stewardship.
